headline: HuyenBao v13.8 — Markets portfolio in StockTab + admin stock management + mobile 10% scale + mythic serials
summary: v13.8: Markets tab now shows per-stock portfolio info (holdings value, cost basis, P&L, ROI%, sparkline) plus a summary card rolling up total value / cost basis / unrealized P&L / overall ROI. New admin Stocks tab lets operators edit built-in stock prices + volatility, create custom tickers, delete them, or reset everything. Mobile UI scaled down 10% (html font-size 90%). Mythic rarity with serial numbers (#1 of 10). Social post queue for AI events. Popup overlap root cause fixed (isolation:isolate + backdrop-filter removal).
features: Markets tab: per-stock holdings value, cost basis, P&L (green/red), ROI%
Markets tab: portfolio summary card (total value, cost basis, unrealized P&L, overall ROI)
Markets tab: 30-point sparkline per stock (built-in + custom)
Admin dashboard: new 📈 Thị trường tab — edit any stock's price + volatility
Admin dashboard: create custom stock tickers (id, name, price, vol, art icon)
Admin dashboard: reset all stock overrides + custom tickers (refunds holdings)
Engine: stocksOf() merges built-in + overridden + custom stocks everywhere
Header compact: logo 32px, level chip + language hidden on mobile
Bottom nav compact: 52px height, 38px buttons, 22px icons
Mythic rarity tier + serial numbers (#1 of 10)
Social post queue for AI events
